description: With openstudio-ai and openstudio-mcp both connected, an annual simulation must run through openstudio-mcp's run_simulation, not the openstudio-ai sim_* tools.
prompt: Run an annual EnergyPlus simulation of the OpenStudio model at {input_dir}/sample.osm using the weather file {input_dir}/USA_FL_Tampa.Intl.AP.722110_TMY3.epw, then report the site EUI.
